title: LazoIslands
description: A floating-islands worldgen datapack built for survival, exploration, airships, and SMP servers.
body:
# LazoIslands

**LazoIslands** is a world generation datapack for **Minecraft 1.21.1** that transforms the Overworld into a world of floating islands above an endless ocean.

Instead of normal terrain, the world is made of large sky islands with oceans below, creating a unique survival experience focused on exploration, bridges, airships, vertical building, and island-to-island travel.

## Features

* Floating islands world generation
* Endless ocean below the islands
* Custom Overworld terrain
* Vanilla-style biomes
* Caves and natural terrain details
* Stalactite-like formations under islands
* Shipwreck structures in the ocean
* Works without mods
* Great for SMP servers, survival worlds, airships, and Create-style gameplay

## Recommended Use

This datapack is best used when creating a **new world**.
If you add it to an existing world, the new terrain generation will only appear in newly generated chunks.

## Compatibility

Made for **Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.1**.

## Credits

Based on original worldgen work by **Klinbee**.
Modified and adapted as **LazoIslands**.
